judged_text: The guest blacklist comparison lowercases the env entries but not the guest email, so a case-varied email bypasses the filter. Blacklisting 'spam@evil.com' in BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS does not block 'Spam@Evil.com' — the blacklisted address is created as an attendee, defeating the operator-configured blacklist.
